_notes.datum: XY follows the sloped console; Y=0 is the inner lower crease; Z=0 is the flat pad. Phone camera end is +Y. Thickness is perpendicular to the pad.
_notes.phone: User confirmed 71.1 x 150 mm. Body thickness 8.8 mm retained, body+housing 11.7, body+lenses 13.8. Bottom back seats at Z=0; the first 36 mm of the phone footprint is clear of print.
_notes.console: Measured nub bases retained: L 18 x 63.5 at Y=88.9; R 18 x 134.62 at Y=19.05; centers X=0 and 93. Finished underside widths 19.4 include legacy 0.5 clearance and 0.2 rim lead-in per side. Rounded 3D nub contours remain provisional.
_notes.nub_openings: Finished upper openings 5.6 mm including all clearances and edge treatments. Right upper end reductions 6 mm lower / 5 mm upper relative to V3 finished mouth. Base openings unchanged. Profiles blend with smoothstep in normalized local thickness.
_notes.camera: Centered 64.5 x 41.5 housing, Y=105 to146.5 in the phone datum. Aperture 65.1 x42.1 with 0.3 per-side clearance. No extra blending relief or opening-enlarging rim chamfer. Housing R6 remains provisional.
_notes.height: Shared outer top plane: Z=1 at Y=0 to Z=4.4 at upper assembly edge. Phone-bearing plane passes through the bottom crease and outer plane at Y=150. Outboard lower structural edges stay 1 mm. Hard installed Z limit 4.5 mm.
_notes.wall: Retain 9/14 mm measured nub-edge-to-wall gaps and 0.5 wall clearance; 9 mm lower outline corners and 0.5 underside rounds are provisional pending contour-gauge measurements A/B/C.
_notes.charging: Retain bottom crease position and central opening. Coil location is not measured; no charging performance claim. Compare the new fit with the bare-phone baseline.
_notes.prototype: V4 physical test authorized despite pending contour data and predicted lens interference. No lens clearance or actual nub fit is certified. Printer dispatch is separate.
_notes.scan: Old scan calibrated to 72.1 mm width is supporting evidence only; new user measurements take precedence.

physical_diagnostics.assumptions: Rigid phone, ideal flat pad, no fabric compression; exact lens positions unmeasured.
physical_diagnostics.scan_status: Historical scan is not a gate: its earlier 72.1 mm width calibration is superseded.
physical_diagnostics.physical_fit_status: UNTESTED: provisional console and nub profiles; no clearance certification.
